question: Should automatically linkified origin become a supported optional field on the exported MarkdownLinkSpan contract, with ambiguous raw HTML anchors preserved?
rationale: The parser-boundary approach is cleaner than Telegram regex inference, but it changes a shared Plugin SDK type and intentionally removes an existing raw-HTML fallback; repository policy requires maintainer intent for that permanent contract and compatibility choice.

options.title: Approve shared provenance
options.body: Accept autoLinked as an additive shared IR contract, retain the raw-HTML behavior change, and require focused contract coverage plus live Telegram proof before merge.

options.title: Keep provenance private
options.body: Use a narrower internal rendering seam or Telegram-owned metadata path so the public MarkdownLinkSpan contract does not expand.

options.title: Preserve HTML fallback
options.body: Keep a separately documented compatibility path for ambiguous raw HTML anchors while using provenance for parsed Markdown links.

recommendation.title: Approve shared provenance
recommendation.body: Accept autoLinked as an additive shared IR contract, retain the raw-HTML behavior change, and require focused contract coverage plus live Telegram proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans Telegram behavior and the shared exported Markdown contract, matching the strongest recent cross-surface ownership signal.
